name: Fondo de Conservación Marina (Costa Rica por Siempre)
summary: Numbered competitive calls for individuals and legal entities to carry out marine-coastal conservation projects in Costa Rica's conservation areas, such as coral restoration, nesting beach monitoring, fisheries management and rat eradication, lasting 12 to 21 months.

eligibility.rule: Project is within the six areas and aligned with its profile and terms
If based in Costa Rica, registered with Hacienda to invoice and enrolled with the CCSS
Budget does not exceed the reference amount in its project profile
Has current occupational-risk insurance covering Costa Rica
Prior ACRXS consultants have a 75%+ rating and no serious fault

documents: Consultant or consulting team curriculum vitae

calls.label: Call No. 14
calls.note: The page still says the call is open until 31 July but gives no year for that date.
